sources.locator: Resolved answer to request-frequency and total-record limit question.
Submission and scope clauses: store valid pairs, allow duplicates, exclude authentication; no application-level volume rule in the Work.

origins.question: Should the app accept every individually valid submission without a request-frequency or total-record limit, or should it enforce a limit? If limited, specify the threshold or time window and what visitors experience when it is reached. The Work requires storing valid submissions, permits duplicates, and excludes authentication; the clarification now requires indefinite retention. A limit could reject an otherwise valid submission, while no limit leaves anonymous persistent data growth unbounded. The supplied repository evidence does not establish whether deployment is externally reachable.
origins.answer: I would not impose limits on request frequency or total record.
